How to play

Fast rounds • Storm closes in • Respawn enabled
  • Move: WASD / arrows (PC) • joystick (mobile)
  • Aim: mouse (PC) • direction you move (touch)
  • Shoot: automatic while aiming (stay on target)
  • Orbs: collect to gain XP and level up
  • Storm: stay inside the circle or you take damage
  • Respawn: after death you come back (5s timer)
